question: In which year did Ambedkar start the Kalaram Temple Entry Satyagraha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1930**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dr. **B. R. Ambedkar** launched the **Kalaram Temple Entry Satyagraha** in **1930** at **Nashik, Maharashtra**.
 
• The movement aimed to secure the **right of Dalits to enter the Kalaram Temple**, which was dedicated to Lord Rama.
 
• On **2 March 1930**, Ambedkar led thousands of followers in a procession towards the Kalaram Temple to demand equal access to the temple.
 
• The movement became an important milestone in Ambedkar's struggle against **untouchability and caste-based discrimination**.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Option 3 – 1930.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Location:** Kalaram Temple, Nashik, Maharashtra.
 
• **Leader:** Dr. B. R. Ambedkar.
 
• **Year:** 1930.
 
• **Objective:** To demand temple entry and equal religious rights for Dalits.
 
• The movement continued for several years and highlighted the broader struggle for **social equality and the eradication of untouchability**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Mahad Satyagraha:** 1927 – associated with the right to access public water sources.
 
• **Kalaram Temple Entry Satyagraha:** **1930** – associated with the demand for temple entry.
 
• **Location:** Nashik, Maharashtra.
